newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: ARGENTINE STOCKS SLUMP TOWARDS CLOSE.
newsitem.headline: ARGENTINE STOCKS SLUMP TOWARDS CLOSE.

text.p: Argentine stocks pulled back in late trading Tuesday imitating a sharp reversal on the U.S. markets, dealers said.
"We were strong at the opening but then the U.S. long bond yield shot up again and people got scared," one dealer said.
He noted investors remained wary of Wednesday's U.S. retail sales and inflation data.
The blue-chip MerVal index fell 1.1 percent to 844.21. It had climbed to 856.15 in early trading to stand fractionally off a five-year high set last Wednesday.
